bridgeRouteRisk.summary: CETES has two native issuance routes and three LayerZero V2 OFT representations. Solana Token-2022 and the classic Stellar CETES issuer are native and remain in Mint Authority; Base, Polygon, and Monad burn source representations and mint destination representations through Etherfuse's TESOURO_OFT / RateLimitedOFTUpgradeable LayerZero path. The same owner EOA controls each EVM OFT's peers, delegate, and rate limits, and a shared ProxyAdmin controls implementation replacement. The EVM route observations are verified, but Monad's implementation source, the complete Monad EID mesh, the Solana-side LayerZero program permissions, and DVN/ULN configuration remain open evidence gaps. Horizon's Stellar authorized balance also differs from Etherfuse's API total and is retained as a separate reconciliation gap rather than bridge evidence.

routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The verified EVM implementation burns in _debit and mints in destination _credit; the current Base mint(address,uint256) probe reverted. Peer/delegate/rate-limit administration and transparent-proxy replacement are separately controlled by the EVM owner and shared ProxyAdmin controls.

controls.evidence: The Base verified TESOURO_OFT / RateLimitedOFTUpgradeable source burns source units in _debit and mints destination units in _credit, so the Base, Polygon, and Monad token contracts are LayerZero representations rather than issuer-native mint surfaces. Fixed-block peers connect each EVM route to Solana EID 30168; the Solana peer identity G26XjZN79HvpTCJKwKCBqw1EWSurUAdTjLwXjB89yBAc is also one signer of the native Solana mint multisig and is retained as an overlapping failure domain.

controls.label: CETES EVM shared ProxyAdmin
controls.capDescription: The shared transparent ProxyAdmin can replace the live OFT implementation on Base, Polygon, and Monad; a replacement can alter mint/burn, peer, or rate-limit logic, but no Safe threshold or timelock was verified.

routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The EIP-1967 admin on all three EVM proxies is 0x322922f0e1675a8e7be2a38b0636a7c184082ca8, whose owner() returns EOA 0xf0a5e0932f2a648dbe6e5089ea37e178dc16600f. Implementations observed were Base 0xd2acc459fd2a8f2ef7a42bff1e61b8d9dc71b678 at block 50064297, Polygon 0x8643d478e074b211b3c8d50f08a417e0c6e2490a at block 92141955, and Monad 0x481e4d19c077a702cde596fda5e24aef6d5149c8 at block 96604174.

controls.evidence: At Base block 50064297, Polygon block 92141955, and Monad block 96604174, the three transparent OFT proxies resolved to the shared ProxyAdmin address 0x322922f0e1675a8e7be2a38b0636a7c184082ca8. Its owner was the same code-empty EOA 0xf0a5e0932f2a648dbe6e5089ea37e178dc16600f. No Safe threshold, timelock, or bounded upgrade delay was verified, so the upgrade failure domain remains adverse and route-scoped.
